column1: # The documented normalization, written out as worked examples.
# checks/verify-counterparts.sh applies one rule and this table states it:
#   fold to lower case, then drop every character that is not a letter or a
#   digit.
# A name is compared to an upstream identifier in its normal form as well as
# verbatim, so case, separator style and package-segment punctuation cannot
# launder a name. Every raw string below is normalized by the check itself and
# required to equal the normal form beside it, so a hand that changes the rule
# in the code without changing the rule as documented fails here. The rows are
# written by hand and are not generated from the code; that is the point of
# them.
# No row names an acquired entry. The rule is about shapes rather than about
# any particular name, and a table of worked examples does not need upstream
# material to say what folding to lower case and dropping punctuation does.
# raw
